title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Cut: 57.7% on 26 attempts; Transition: 55.0% on 20 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 45.9% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers. Transition: sprint back, stop the ball first and match up second.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 45.9% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Transition: 3 TO in 23 uses (13.0% vs 9.4% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
